column1: # UG-02 pin history (runtime data ledger rev 5; read by tests/runtime_data_ledger_gate.rs).
# APPEND-ONLY. The last line must equal the counts over the ledger. Line to line every count
# only falls, except on a `merge-raise` line with a reason (03 section 2: a merge that adds
# rows re-derives them in the same commit). `prev` is the FNV-1a 64 hash of the previous
# line. Only the first line is anchored (GENESIS in the gate code): rewriting it is RED. The
# hash chain catches a later line edited in place and not re-chained, but it is no anchor -
# a re-chained edit passes - so lines 2..N are append-only by the merge recipe, which checks
# that `git diff --numstat <base>` deletes no line of this file (PC-k), not by the gate.
